suppress.notes: Internal tooling, not exposed to the Internet. I cannot even see what our tech stack has to do with that vulernability in the mobile dev tool LINE, just that the name occurs in 'pi-test-command-line'?

False positive: the advisory lists 6.5.0 through 6.5.10 as affected, our 6.5.11 already contains the fix, but OSS-Index still flags it. Additionally, the vulnerable SubjectDnX509PrincipalExtractor is X.509 client-certificate authentication, which we do not use anywhere (JWT and API-key authentication only).

Not applicable: decodeFromCompressedByteBuffer decodes attacker-supplied compressed histograms, but micrometer only records and encodes histograms, it never decodes external input. No fixed HdrHistogram release exists yet.

Not applicable: the flawed range check in DoubleHistogram.recordValue requires local access and histogram values recorded by micrometer are timings, not external input. No fixed HdrHistogram release exists yet.
